blocks.html: Nor do the tokens which the witnesses report count for anything: for by what is said above it is sufficiently answered that the witnesses have been validly objected to. Added to which, there are very few tokens given by them which are not found in the said accused, save for the height and the bulk; but as to that, the answer is easy: inasmuch as, as other witnesses not objected to depose, although the accused, when he departed, appeared taller, longer and more slender, nevertheless, since then, by the course of years, he would have filled out in body and grown stronger in the legs.
